changeSet.sql:
-- 1. Jadvalni yaratish CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document.report ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, document_id UUID NOT NULL, seller_id UUID, buyer_id UUID, name_uz TEXT, name_ru TEXT, name_en TEXT, number INTEGER, status TEXT , template_json TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_by UUID, created_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(), last_modified_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() );
-- 3. Tezkor qidiruv uchun indekslar (ixtiyoriy, lekin tavsiya etiladi) CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_report_document_id ON document.report(document_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_report_seller_id ON document.report(seller_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_report_buyer_id ON document.report(buyer_id);
